name: Scalingo
line: Deploy and run managed app containers and databases.

free.text: 30-day trial; payment method; 1 app/5 S-M containers; delete before expiry

cells.regions: Paris; secure zone needs EU org + legitimate need

work.math: The S plan costs €7.30 for 730 hours. 100 GB of transfer and a custom-domain HTTPS certificate are included. Add the unknown build cost for 100 build minutes, so the full total is unknown.
The XL plan is €58.40 for 730 hours, plus the unknown build cost for 100 minutes. 2048 MB is more than 1 GiB, but no container has a verified 1 vCPU allocation.

€87.60 for 730 hours includes the XL plan and a 2G database (2 GB RAM, 40 GB storage, 7 daily backups). Same-region 10 GB database traffic is €0. Add the unknown build cost. The small app API's 1 vCPU fit is unverified.
